Jade_Shyvana.name: Shyvana
Jade_Shyvana.lore:
- Dragon's Descent (R) has a different passive and properties
- Passive, Q, W, E are completely different, including Dragon Form abilities. Read the ability descriptions
Jade_Shyvana.blurb:
- Dragon's Descent (R) has a different passive and properties
- Passive, Q, W, E are completely different, including Dragon Form abilities. Read the ability descriptions

spells.name: Twin Bite
spells.description: Shyvana strikes twice on her next attack. Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Twin Bite by 0.5 seconds. Dragon Form: Twin Bite cleaves all units in front Shyvana.
spells.tooltip:
Shyvana strikes twice on her next attack, dealing {{ calc_bonus_damage }} physical damage on the second attack. Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Twin Bite by {{ cooldown_reduction }} seconds.

Dragon Form: Twin Bite cleaves all units in front of Shyvana.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Burnout
spells.description: Shyvana surrounds herself in fire, dealing magic damage per second to nearby enemies and moving faster for 3 seconds. The movement speed reduces over the duration of the spell. Basic attacks extend the duration of Burnout. Dragon Form: Burnout scorches the ground beneath it, enemies on the scorched earth continue to take damage.
spells.tooltip:
Shyvana deals {{ damage }} magic damage per second to nearby enemies and moves {{ basemovespeed*100 }}% faster for {{ movespeedduration }} seconds. Shyvana's Move Speed bonus is reduced over time. Basic attacks extend the duration of Burnout by {{ durationincreaseperhit }} second to a maximum of {{ maxdurationincrease }} seconds.

Dragon Form: Burnout scorches the earth, continuing to damage enemies that stand on it.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Flame Breath
spells.description: Shyvana unleashes a fireball that deals damage to all enemies it encounters and leaves cinders on the target marking them for 4 seconds. Basic attacks on marked targets deal a percentage of their maximum health as damage on-hit. Dragon Form: Flame Breath engulfs all units in a cone in front of her.
spells.tooltip:
Shyvana unleashes a fireball that deals {{ damage }} magic damage to targets hit, debuffing them and reducing their Armor by {{ armorshred*100 }}% for {{ debuffduration }} seconds. Basic attacks to debuffed targets deal {{ bonusdamage }} magic damage On-Hit.

Dragon Form: Flame Breath fires in a cone in front of her.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Dragon's Descent
spells.description: Shyvana transforms into a dragon and takes flight to a target location. Enemies along her path take damage and are knocked toward her target location. Shyvana passively gains Armor and Magic Resistance. Defensive bonuses are doubled in Dragon Form.
spells.tooltip:
Active: Shyvana transforms into a dragon and takes flight to a target location. Enemies along her path take {{ damage }} magic damage and are knocked toward her target location.

Passive: Shyvana reinforces her scales, increasing her Armor and Magic Resist by {{ seasonone_armormrgain }}. Defensive bonuses are doubled in Dragon Form.

While in Dragon Form Shyvana's abilities have additional effects.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Fury of the Dragonborn
passive.description: Shyvana's basic attacks enhance her abilities.
